title: Crucible Reaction Prompts
description: Watches combat for moments when a character could use a reaction (e.g. Reactive Strike when an enemy leaves engagement, Counterspell when an enemy casts a spell, or Counter-Riposte/Counter-Strike/Counter-Evade/Defensive Roll/Repercussive Block right after a successful melee defense) and posts a chat card to that character's owner(s) and the GM with a one-click 'Use it?' button. Built to be extended: register additional actions against the same triggers, or add new trigger types, via game.modules.get('crucible-reaction-prompts').api.
